sloka: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने ।शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा ।। ५.३९.२६।।।।
transliteration: trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṁ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane ।śaktiḥ syādvainateyasya tava vā mārutasya vā ।। 5.39.26।।।।

translations.english: "It is only three beings who have the capacity to leap over this ocean. Garuda, or you or the Windgod.
